summary: In this excerpt from a fiction book (Book 14, part 92), the narrator and companions Nikko and Bree find a sick, injured man named Wheeze hiding in a dilapidated shack near the water. Wheeze, who had sent a note with directions, is feverish, shaking, and unable to walk, so they help him to the car. Bree examines his badly swollen ankle, gives him Vicodin and a sports drink, and wraps the ankle in elastic bandage.
one_line: Narrator, Nikko and Bree rescue the feverish, injured Wheeze from a derelict shack and tend his swollen ankle in the car.
key_facts: The narrator searches a dilapidated shack for a man named Wheeze, who had sent a note giving directions.
A hoarse voice inside the shack claims to have a knife before the narrator recognizes Wheeze.
Wheeze is shaking with cold, his skin feels hot to the touch, and his eyes look unfocused.
Wheeze had surrounded himself with cardboard and dead leaves to keep warm.
Nikko and the narrator help Wheeze out of the shed and through the trees to the car, with him hopping and being dragged.
Bree examines Wheeze's ankle after he lowers himself onto the backseat of the car.
Wheeze describes his ankle as 'pretty messed up' and coughs in a wheezy, gasping moan.
Bree removes Wheeze's boot, which is noisy and difficult to take off.
Wheeze's leg is so swollen that the narrator compares it to an elephant's leg from an exotic tropical disease.
Bree gives Wheeze Vicodin pills left over from her wisdom teeth removal, and he drinks a neon-colored sports drink to swallow them.
Bree cuts off Wheeze's grotty sock and wraps the ankle with stretchy elastic bandage.
Bree's roommate plays Lacrosse and the group has a ton of elastic bandages from her.
Wheeze clamps his teeth on his lower lip as his face goes white and sweaty while the wrap is secured with metal clips.
Wheeze had earlier told the narrator stories about creepy guys he met while riding the rails.
